page.overview:
Who is Kilo?

Kilo, nicknamed Baby Kilo, is a baby Velociraptor that could be seen at Universal Studios Singapore. Kilo was first shown off around July 25, 2023.

Kilo could be met at Universal Orlando Singapore, where visitors could greet her. Kilo was carried by a professional handler, and was comfortable being held by them. Kilo enjoys under-chin scratches. She is six months old.

Kilo can be seen at the Raptor Encounter: Generations attraction at Universal Singapore alongside VEL-009 and Blue.

Kilo is bright green with a brown line all the way down her back.
